title: Polygenic scores for psychiatric traits mediate the impact of multigenerational history of depression on offspring psychopathology
abstract: Using cross-sectional ABCD data from 8,111 children, this study found that a depression polygenic score was associated with both multigenerational depression history and offspring psychopathology and statistically mediated 1.39–5.87% of their observed association. The analysis does not establish a causal transmission mechanism.
